insights.one_liner: AFS Energy is an employee-owned Amsterdam broker in environmental commodities with 195+ staff from 25+ nationalities, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: An independent, employee-owned financial and environmental intermediary with 195+ colleagues from 25+ nationalities.
Focuses on environmental commodities and serves 3,000+ clients in 50+ countries.
Its risk team covers market, credit, liquidity and currency risk and reports straight to the Risk Director and CEO.

open.text: AFS Energy B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, an entry-level risk role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.
Staff come from more than 25 nationalities.

growth.text: Claims more than 175 years of heritage; its ultimate owner is Dutch firm Clip Brokers B.V.
